## How it was verified
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npx playwright test` (UI changes)
- [ ] Screenshots attached for visible changes

## Security checklist
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, `.env` files or real data committed
- [ ] New endpoints require authentication and the correct role
- [ ] User input is validated (zod) and output is escaped
- [ ] New dependencies are pinned, maintained, and pass `npm audit`
